# Archive

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

Format-neutral archive factory backed by unarc-rs. No board access checks are performed.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#reading-archives-400).

## Formats

```PPL
Archive.Formats() STRING[]
```

Static function.

Returns the format names supported by the installed unarc-rs backend as a STRING array.

## Open

```PPL
Archive.Open(STRING path, [ArchiveOptions options]) ArchiveReader
```

Static function.

Opens an archive using content detection and filename hints, or an explicit format. Failure returns an invalid reader and updates Error.Last().

## Options

```PPL
Archive.Options() ArchiveOptions
```

Static function.

Creates default opening options: 16 MiB per entry, 64 MiB total and 10,000 entries.
